source.description: Candidate source plus the phase-two transfer; not a final release commit.

sanitization: Only software test results are retained. Research paths, titles, source-file inventories, document content and screenshots are excluded.

linux.evidenceKind: Execution results supplied by the coordinating agent; no raw Linux command log is embedded in this summary.

skippedTests.name: scoped Git checkpoints does not treat a non-executable hook file as an enabled hook

windows.additionalCommandEvidence: Windows typecheck, build and Biome results supplied by the coordinating agent.

previousWindowsRun.diagnosis: The OS returned EACCES while binding the existing deterministic TCP writer-lock port.
previousWindowsRun.resolution: Production still uses the compatible fixed lock and fails closed, now preserving the OS error in diagnostics. Test fixtures select a fresh directory whose derived port is available; cross-process old-writer exclusion and reopen-after-crash are covered.
previousWindowsRun.rawReceiptStatus: Earlier failing counts were supplied by the coordinating agent and remain recorded here; the passing raw receipt is linked above.

packaging.note: Passing code gates do not establish a self-contained executable or successful installation.
